title: Restaurant Review Analysis Report
executive_summary: An analysis of 34 customer reviews for Johnny's Jamaican Grill reveals high overall satisfaction with minor, occasional concerns regarding food quality consistency during peak hours.
key_findings: Occasional complaints noted regarding food quality inconsistency, affecting approximately 8.8% of the analyzed reviews.

root_causes.pattern: Occasional complaints about food quality inconsistency.
root_causes.cause: Inconsistent kitchen preparation or ingredient variance during peak hours.

recommendations.issue: Inconsistent kitchen preparation and ingredient variance during peak hours leading to food quality complaints.
recommendations.action: Implement standardized recipe cards at every kitchen station, establish mandatory pre-shift line checks, and designate a quality control expediter during peak service hours to inspect all dishes before they leave the pass.
recommendations.expected_impact: Reduction in food quality variance, higher consistency across shifts, and improved customer satisfaction scores.

limitations: The analysis is based on a relatively small sample size of 34 reviews, which may not capture all customer sentiments or seasonal variations.
